# LegatorOCR v0.2.0-pre.39 (pre-release)

Audit round on top of pre.38 (pre.35 to pre.38 drafts are superseded; publish only this one). Written and tried by the author's assistant on one Linux machine. The automated test suite passes on CI runners for Linux x86-64 and arm64, Windows x86-64 and arm64, and macOS. **Nothing was tried by hand on Windows, macOS or arm64.**

**Fixed (found by deliberately hostile inputs and by comparing with other readers)**
- Signing: every signature field now gets a unique name (`Signature1`, `Signature2`, ...). Before, a second signature reused the first name and some validators then rejected the earlier signature.
- Signing a file that uses object streams now refuses a file that already has a signature (`/ByteRange`) instead of silently invalidating it.
- Decrypting/rewriting: PDFs with absurdly sparse object numbers (a few bytes claiming object 4 billion) are refused instead of allocating gigabytes.
- `--jbig2` symbol matching is bounded: speckled pages no longer take quadratic time.
- PDF toolbox: document information (title, author, subject, keywords) is kept, and `--author/--subject/--keywords` are honoured.
- PDF toolbox and linearize: links that point to pages that were dropped are removed, links to kept pages are renumbered to the new pages; no more `null` destinations.
- `--figure` for a page that is not in the document now warns instead of staying silent.
- Help texts for `--linearize`, `--object-streams` and `--sign-pdf` corrected.

**Verified**: new unit and CLI tests for each fix; fmt, clippy `-D warnings`, full workspace tests; `scripts/crossread.py` (poppler, pdfium, MuPDF, qpdf, pikepdf, pypdf, pyHanko) now also covers qpdf-encrypted input in every mode, page links and metadata carry-over, multiple signatures; fuzzed toolbox/sign/linearize inputs, decompression bombs (3 GB), hostile `--figure` values and unusual passwords gave no crash and no hang.

**Not verified**: Acrobat and Foxit; the window and the command line by hand on Windows, macOS and arm64; veraPDF on real scans (CI covers small synthetic pages only).

**Known limits**: the toolbox drops outlines (bookmarks) and form fields, as documented; named destinations in links are dropped; other limits of pre.38 stand.
